newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Fogade to sell 3 seats on Caracas bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Fogade to sell 3 seats on Caracas bolsa.

text.p: Venezuelan state Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade said Monday it plans to auction three seats on the Caracas Stock Exchange.
The date and minimum price for the seats will be announced 15 days before the auction, Fogade said in a release.
Fogade successfully sold two seats on the exchange for 400 million bolivars ($860,000) on September 26.
The sales are part of Fogade's program to sell off assets it received in exchange for financial aid during the 1994-5 financial sector crisis.
